files.installs/scpsl/worldcradle-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# worldcradle-managed SCP: Secret Laboratory server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/scpsl/worldcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="<ROOT>/installs/scpsl/worldcradle-servers/test"
CONSOLE="<ROOT>/installs/scpsl/worldcradle-servers/test/server.log.console"
: > "$CONSOLE"
# The server's console is fed from the file above, so the dashboard can type
# commands into it.
cd "<ROOT>/installs/scpsl/" || exit 1
exec ./LocalAdmin 7777 --acceptEULA --useDefault --noSetCursor \
    > "<ROOT>/installs/scpsl/worldcradle-servers/test/server.log" 2>&1 < <(tail -n0 -F "$CONSOLE")
files.installs/scpsl/worldcradle-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
echo "exit" >> "<ROOT>/installs/scpsl/worldcradle-servers/test/server.log.console"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 15 ] && pgrep -f -- 'LocalAdmin 7777 --acceptEULA' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
